column1: # StatCan survey → subject mapping. EDIT THE `subjects` COLUMN (6th field).
# The taxonomy is Statistics Canada’s, captured from their subject facet. Where a program appears
# in the data portal's Subject facet, its tags are StatCan's own: crawled 2026-09-29 from
# ~58 groups (RDC/admin-data files the portal does not list as data programs — LSIC, APS, LISA,
# CAF*, SGVP, vital-statistics databases…) are hand-assigned from each file's own data-dictionary
# title and how StatCan tags sibling programs. This file is the source of truth for all of it.
# Format: pipe-separate multiple subjects, e.g.  Health|Children and youth
#         leave blank to leave a survey unclassified (shown as unclassified, not guessed).
# Spelling must match the taxonomy exactly; the loader reports anything it does not recognize.
# suggest_name    — from the official survey title. Higher precision; a title is a deliberate label.
# suggest_content — from variable text. Lower precision: it filed CHMS under Languages and put
#                   Transportation on CCHS. Offered for reference, not as an answer.
